title: Lockup: Indiana: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Brotherhood
Using a form of integration at Indiana State that goes beyond race, the Residential Treatment Unit selects inmates with a history of good behavior to live with and serve as mentors to inmates with mental health issues.

title: Lockup: Sacramento: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — 352,955 Days to Life
One inmate contends that a law could put him away forever; an inmate sentenced to life without parole prays that a new law will set him free.

title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Troubled Waters
A massive search for contraband throughout the facility turns up the heat on two inmates inside the Santa Rosa Correctional Institution; a convict prompts an evacuation when he floods his housing unit.

title: Lockup: Oakland: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Wait of the World
A violent gang member asks to move back to general population, following six years in segregation; a brother and sister are charged with murdering a high school football star, two years after he was stabbed to death on an Oakland street corner.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — There Goes the Neighborhood
Welcome to Limon Correctional Facility, a level 4 prison that houses many of Colorado's most dangerous inmates; while visiting Limon Correctional, the Lockup crew is greeted by angry inmates and the cell extraction team is called in to help.

title: Lockup Special Investigation
description:
S1 E1 — Lake County Juvenile Justice: Kenneth, Kentrell, Devon
For some kids, the revolving door of lockup seems to snag one generation after the next; 17-year-old Kenneth and 14-year-old Kentrell have 10 brothers and sisters, a father in prison and a mother with a criminal record for public nuisance.

title: Lockup Special Investigation
description:
S1 E5 — Lake County Juvenile Justice: Rodrick, Morris
More than three thousand kids pass through the juvenile courts in Lake County, Indiana each year; here, consequences can range from a sleepless night in detention to the ultimate punishment for kids who keep coming back: Boys' School.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S2 E6 — The Revolving Door
Three unforgettable inmates, each one about to cross the threshold to freedom; witness their joys, their fears, their triumphs and discover that sometimes the only thing tougher than being in prison, is staying out.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S3 E8 — A Private Hell
For some, prison might be hell, and it can be even worse for the sex offenders.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S5 E3 — A Brotherhood of Gangs
How gangs are managed in the jail system; how family relationships affect the jail experience.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S6 E1 — A Young People's Guide to Jail
An exploration of first-time inmates that look like they should be sitting in classrooms rather than jail cells.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S5 E12 — Trouble in Tulsa
The troublemakers of the jail system and how correctional officers control the situation caused by these troublemakers.
